name: Zoho AI (Zia)
pricing_tiers: Zoho CRM Plus (with Zia): $57/user/month. Zoho CRM Enterprise: $40/user/month. Zoho CRM Professional: $23/user/month. Zoho One (all 40+ apps with Zia): $45/user/month (all-employee pricing). Free CRM tier available for up to 3 users. Zia included in all paid CRM plans — no separate AI add-on cost.
free_tier_available: yes — Zoho CRM Free (up to 3 users, basic Zia features); 15-day trial for advanced tiers
latest_major_release: Zia AI enhancements throughout 2025-2026: predictive analytics, conversational AI, anomaly detection, workflow suggestions, AI-powered data enrichment; Zoho CRM continuously updated
key_capabilities: predictive lead scoring, sales forecasting (Zia Predictions), conversational AI assistant, anomaly detection/alerts, workflow automation suggestions, AI-powered data enrichment, sentiment analysis, email sentiment, best time to contact, deal stage predictions
integrations: native Zoho ecosystem (40+ apps: CRM, Books, People, Desk, Campaigns, Analytics, Projects); 1,000+ third-party integrations via Zoho Marketplace; Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, Slack, Mailchimp, Stripe, PayPal, Zapier; open API
smb_onboarding_time: hours to 2 days (guided setup wizard; Zia auto-activates; pre-built workflows/templates available)
mobile_support: Zoho CRM mobile app (iOS/Android) with Zia voice commands, deal management, notifications; full-featured mobile experience
estimated_smb_users: 80 million+ total Zoho users across all products; Zoho CRM used by 250,000+ businesses; strong SMB dominance in India/Asia markets
market_differentiator: most affordable full-suite AI — Zia included at no extra cost across all CRM tiers; 40+ integrated apps under Zoho One ($45/all-employee); best price-to-capability ratio for SMBs; no per-feature AI upcharges
key_competitors: Salesforce Einstein, HubSpot AI, Freshworks Freddy, Microsoft Dynamics 365 Copilot
typical_roi_claim: Zoho claims 40% increase in lead conversion, 30% reduction in sales cycle time, 25% improvement in forecast accuracy with Zia; customers report 10-15 hrs/week saved on data entry
smb_adoption_trend: growing — Zoho's SMB-first strategy and aggressive pricing (Zia included free) driving adoption; expanding beyond India into global SMB markets
notable_smb_case_studies: Real estate agency used Zia to automate lead scoring saving 15 hrs/week; small manufacturer used Zia workflow automation to reduce order processing time by 40%
funding_to_date: Zoho: $1B+ annual revenue (2025 est.); bootstrapped, no external funding; profitable since inception
partner_ecosystem: 1,000+ Zoho Marketplace apps; Zoho Partner Program with resellers and implementation partners globally; strong system integrator network in Asia
community_support: Zoho Community (forums), Zoho Academy (free training), Zoho CRM documentation, Zoholics annual user conference, extensive YouTube tutorials
